confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because summer rates vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker, so they were set from typical Bucharest bar and restaurant price relationships to beer. The USD_PER_AUD FX value came from a search summary of the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page, not a directly fetched page, so verify it against the RBA F11.1 table if exact provenance matters.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Eastern European capitals with similar tourist and restaurant price levels, such as Sofia and Budapest, adjusted for Bucharest's generally lower restaurant and hotel prices. Prices assume July 2026 peak-season demand.
